sn54.2:1.1: Ānāpānasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ānāpānasatisahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ānāpānasatisahagatam dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ || viriya || pīti || passaddhi || samādhi || ānāpānasatisahagatam upekkhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || || Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti || || 1--2. Sāvatthi
